main_text.l: rum, uti est decreto Ordinum statutum;
de qua quotannis mense Februario in
rationes menstruas de iis, quæ ejus curæ
commissa sunt, apud hos eosdem red-
dit. Et licet etiam curatoribus adscisceré
sibi matronas duas honestas rei œcono-
inspectionis in se recipiant, sed gratuitò
similiter, ut ipsi curatores. Hoc ἐγκρα-
τεῖον[?] multis malis terrori, multis etiam
superiore M. DC. XIV instituta, & solen-

page.notes: The initial C of "Coronis" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the following word as "CORONIS". The Greek word after "Hoc" is hyphenated across the line end and is hard to read; the reading ἐγκρα-τεῖον is a best guess and is marked [?]. The faint "Digitized by Google" mark at the lower right is not transcribed.
